adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts`, when the parsed token data lacks `refresh_token`, the code sets `refreshTokenResponse.data.refresh_token = "refresh_token"` (line ~25). In `packages/app-store/office365calendar/lib/CalendarService.ts`, the returned `tokenResponse.data` is spread into the stored credentials (`o365AuthCredentials = { ...o365AuthCredentials, ...(tokenResponse.success && tokenResponse.data) };`), so a missing `refresh_token` from the provider/sync endpoint would overwrite the real DB refresh token with the literal placeholder. The Google Calendar part of the finding is less directly supported (it passes `googleCredentials`, which already contains a refresh token), but the Office365 overwrite is clearly a real defect exposed by this diff.
